opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__facts:
This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 on behalf of applicant relating to Crime No. 255/2023, registered at Police Station-khargone,
District-Khargone for the offence under Sections 376, 457, 506 of I.P.C.
He is in jail since 09.05.2023.
opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__arguments:
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
FIR is delayed by one months and three days.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the prayer and prays for rejection of the application of the applicant for grant of bail.
opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__ANALYSIS: No proper explanation for delay is given by the prosecution.
opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__decision:
The prosecutrix is a major lady.
The applicant is in custody since 09.05.2023.
Investigation is over and chargesheet has been filed.
Therefore, counsel for the applicant prays that the benefit of grant of bail be given to the applicant and he be enlarged on bail.
4 . Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and rival submissions of the counsel for the parties and looking to the custody period of the applicant, I deem it proper to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
5 . The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he/she shall remain present before the Court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
6. This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
7. The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

This second bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (equivalent to Section 439 of Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the applicant Suresh for grant of regular bail,
who has been arrested on 16.02.2024 in connection with Crime No.46/2024 registered at Police Station Raipuriya, Dist. Jhabua (M.P.) for commission of offences under Section 376(1), 323 of IPC.
First application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after four months from today vide order dated 15.10.2024 passed in MCRC No.41240/2024.
2.
opennyai_summary.11_March_2025__arguments:
There is no sufficient evidence available on NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6635 2 MCRC-10505-2025 record to establish the complicity of the accused with the alleged crime.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving his family, home and profession and also there is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by applicant.
opennyai_summary.11_March_2025__ANALYSIS: 5 . In the aforesaid factual backdrop, looking to the incarceration period, completion of investigation and also taking into consideration the fact that the trial is not going to conclude in near future, this Court is inclined to grant benefit of bail to the applicant.
opennyai_summary.11_March_2025__decision:
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
6.
